headline: Texas Elementary School Named After Retired Custodian Marilyn Hampton
meta_description: Aubrey Independent School District honors Marilyn Hampton, a retired custodian who gave 39 years of service and impact beyond her job.
summary_short: A new elementary school in Texas will bear the name of Marilyn Hampton, a retired custodian who spent 39 years at Aubrey Independent School District.
body:
A new elementary school in Texas will be named after Marilyn Hampton, a retired custodian who spent 39 years at Aubrey Independent School District. The decision reflects far more than recognition of her tenure in the custodial department.

Hampton's legacy extends well beyond the typical duties of her role. Over nearly four decades of service, she became woven into the fabric of the district, touching the lives of students and staff in ways that inspired the district to immortalize her name on a school building.

The naming represents a rare honor—one that acknowledges how a single person's commitment and care can transform a workplace and community. In choosing to name the new elementary school after Hampton, Aubrey ISD recognized that her contribution transcended janitorial work, making her a fitting symbol of dedication for the students who will walk those halls.

39 years of service as a custodian in Texas schools
New elementary school will bear her name
